description:
Dive into the mysterious world of cartography with Graham Hancock as he reveals the secrets behind the world's original map. Explore ancient civilizations, challenge conventional understanding, and reshape the narrative of our past. Uncover hidden knowledge and archaeological insights on lost civilizations, historical discoveries, and the rewriting of history.
